findings.evidence: The accepted specification requires the whole answer to be withheld if a current Document becomes superseded or its Source Anchor support becomes unavailable before rendering. The plan simultaneously requires exactly one bounded evidence read, and the Chat contract exposes and invokes only RetrieveAsync once. It then claims that the server re-reads every retained span and resolves every fixed handle to a current Document immediately before render. Re-reading the request-retained immutable Section text and recomputing its support signature detects tampering but cannot detect that a Logical Document current-version pointer, Source Anchor availability, or required exact relationship changed in PostgreSQL during provider latency. The planned ChatAgentResultValidator belongs to Agents and cannot query Infrastructure under the accepted layering. The existing knowledge-store implementation demonstrates the seam: current-version identity is queried during retrieval, followed only by an authorization recheck before return. No planned Infrastructure-owned post-provider currentness operation closes this time-of-check/time-of-render gap. Consequently the artifacts do not provide an executable proof for the supersession edge case, FR-010, FR-011, FR-012, SC-001, or SC-002.
findings.exact_correction_outcome: Add a provider-independent Core currentness-validation contract implemented only by Infrastructure, for example ValidateCurrentAsync over the request ID, Evidence Fingerprint, selected Document Version/Stable Section/span identities, fixed Source Anchor set, and exact relationship support. PreparedChatCoordinator must invoke it after selection-only provider validation and immediately before the final Repository authorization check and render. In one bounded serializable validation read it must prove that each Logical Document still points to the same current Document Version; every Stable Section and exact substring/hash still exists; every fixed Source Anchor remains same-version, selected-Repository, safe, and has an available positive line range; and every required REFERENCES/GENERATED_FROM relationship, profile, and direction remains current and authorized. Any mismatch returns the existing whole-answer missing/stale failure with zero claims or citations. Update the performance and call-order text from exactly one evidence read to one bounded retrieval plus one bounded currentness validation; do not hold a database transaction open across the provider call. Add deterministic barrier-controlled tests that supersede a Document Version and invalidate required support after retrieval/provider dispatch but before validation, requiring whole-answer rejection. Preserve the existing selection-only provider schema, exact-span/support-signature checks, and post-validation Repository authorization recheck.

constitution_result.evidence: Core/Infrastructure/Agents/Web ownership, specific repository boundaries, immutable Document Versions, Chinese UI, embedded prompts, encrypted provider secrets, exact Cross-Repository vocabulary, no-migration intent, and the corrected final-container harness comply. Principle IV remains unmet because the required supersession/support-loss window has no executable production seam or deterministic test. Principle V remains unmet because stale evidence can still pass retained-object validation and reach rendering after its currentness was revoked. No system-wide or context ADR file and no root CONTEXT-MAP.md exists at the pinned boundary, so no ADR conflict was found.

rationale: The corrected iteration-3 artifacts fully close both original High findings and all three iteration-2 contradictions. The final provider/app topology, Playwright preparation, Data Protection, Identity, health, and cleanup contracts are feasible against the pinned seams. ACCEPT is nevertheless prohibited because the complete plan promises immediate pre-render currentness while structurally allowing only the original retrieval read; immutable retained spans cannot reveal that their Logical Document ceased to be current during provider latency. This is a correctable High/MUST deterministic-grounding and failure-behavior gap, not an unresolvable external-authority conflict, so REVISE rather than BLOCKED is required. As this is the maximum iteration, lifecycle progression requires root escalation.
